extends.compatibility: legacy prompt-only v2 requests and rows remain the 124-frame, 20 STEP, 414720-pixel profile; new writers include requested.profileId and the separate steps and canvas-tier capabilities add their independent requested fields

healthCapability.oldCompanionBehavior: reject locally with restart guidance and do not reserve or enqueue a job

requested.prompt: trimmed UTF-16 string up to 2000 code units

request.arbitraryControls: reject unknown profile ids and arbitrary duration, frame, FPS, or resolution fields; STEP is governed by PV-ENHANCE-VIDEO-H3-STEPS-001 and maximumPixelArea by PV-ENHANCE-VIDEO-H3-CANVAS-TIERS-001
